senses.gloss:
सोपकरण a. Provided with all requisite materials or implements,
 properly equipped; सहोढं सोपकरणं घातयेदविचारयन् Ms. 9. 270.

सोपकार a.
—1 = सोपकरण.
—2 Assisted, befriended.
—3 Beneficial (as a deposit in pawn); न त्वेवाधौ सोपकारे कौसीदीं वृद्धिमाप्नुयात् Ms. 8. 143.
सोपक्रम a. Undertaken.
सोपग्रहम् ind. In a conciliatory or friendly manner.
सोपचय a. Profitable.
सोपचार a. Acting politely, civil, courteous.
सोपद्रव a. Visited with calamities or afflictions.

सोपध a.
—1 Full of fraud or deceit, deceitful.
—2 What is given away with an end in view; Dānasāgara, Bibl. Ind. 274, Fasc. 1 p. 45.
—3 With penultimate letter.

सोपधान a.
—1 Cushioned.
—2 Possessing (excellent) qualities; सोपधानां धियं धीराः स्थेयसीं
 खट्वयन्ति ये Śi. 2. 77.
—3 Furnished, set.

सोपधि a. Fraudulent. ━ind. Deceitfully, fraudulently; अरिषु
 हि विजयाथिंनः क्षितीशा विदधति सोपधि संधिदूषणानि Ki. 1. 45.

सोपाधि a., सोपाधिक a. (-की f.)
—1 Restricted by some conditions or limitations, qualified by particular
 characteristics, limited, qualified (in phil.).
—2 Having some peculiar attribute.
—3 Special.
सोपन्यास, सोपपत्तिक a. Well-founded or substantiated.
सोपन्यास, सोपपत्तिक a. Well-founded or substantiated.

सोपप्लव a.
—1 Afflicted with any great calamity.
—2 Invaded or overrun by enemies.
—3 Eclipsed (as the sun or moon); ब्रह्मघोषैर्विरहितः पर्वतोऽयं न
 शोभते । रजसा तमसा चैव सोमः सोपप्लवो यथा ॥ Mb. 12. 328. 13.

सोपरोध a.
—1 Obstructed, impeded.
—2 Favoured.
सोपरोध + .{@-धम्@} ind. Obligingly, respectfully.

सोपसर्ग a.
—1 Afflicted or visited by any great calamity or misfortune.
—2 Portentous.
—3 Possessed by an evil spirit.
—4 Preceded by a prepositional prefix (in gram.).
सोपस्नेहता Moisture; (see उपस्नेहः); Cārudatta 3.
सोपहास a. Accompanied with derisive laughter, sneering, sarcastic.
सोपहास + .{@-सम्@} ind. Sneeringly, with a sneer.

सोपाकः A man of a degraded caste; चण्डालेन तु सोपाको मूलव्यसनवृत्तिमान् ।
 पुक्कस्यां जायते पापः सदा सज्जनगर्हितः ॥ Ms. 10. 38.
सोपादान a. Furnished with materials.

सोपाधि a., सोपाधिक a. (-की f.)
—1 Restricted by some conditions or limitations, qualified by particular
 characteristics, limited, qualified (in phil.).
—2 Having some peculiar attribute.
—3 Special.

सोपाधि a., सोपाधिक a. (-की f.)
—1 Restricted by some conditions or limitations, qualified by particular
 characteristics, limited, qualified (in phil.).
—2 Having some peculiar attribute.
—3 Special.

सोपानम् Steps, stairs, a staircase, ladder; आरोहणार्थं नवयौवनेन
 कामस्य सोपानमिव प्रयुक्तम् Ku. 1. 39.
.━{@Comp.@}: सोपानपङ्क्तिः, सोपानमाला

सोपानम् + -पङ्क्तिः f., {@-पथः, -पद्धतिः@} f., {@-परंपरा, -मार्गः@}
 a flight of steps, a stair-case; वापी चास्मिन्
 मरकतशिलाबद्धसोपानमार्गा Me. 78; समारुरुक्षुर्दिवमायुषः क्षये
 ततान सोपानपरंपरामिव R. 3. 69, 6. 3, 16. 56.
सोपानम् + -माला winding stairs.

सोपानत्क, सोपानह् a. Having a shoe on; सोपानत्के पादे
 द्वितीयामुपानहमशक्यत्वान्नोपादत्ते ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 33.
